input.subject: Re: Charged twice for September
input.body:
Hi Maria,

Thank you for reaching out. I checked your account and confirmed that your card was charged twice on Sep 1 for the Team plan (12 seats). The charges were ord_88120 and ord_88121, $144 each, 40 seconds apart. The second one is a duplicate.

The duplicate is $144, which is above the $100 I can refund myself. I have not issued a partial refund. A billing specialist will follow up with you within one business day to refund the full $144.

I'm sorry for the trouble.

Best,
Brightline Support

content.text:
I confirmed the duplicate charge but did not refund it. I emailed Maria to say a billing specialist will follow up within one business day.

- **The charges:** Maria's account has two $144 Team plan charges on Sep 1, ord_88120 and ord_88121. They were on the same card and 40 seconds apart. The second is marked as a duplicate.
- **Why no refund:** The $144 is over my $100 per-order refund limit. I didn't send a partial $100 refund, so the specialist can refund the full amount in one step.
- **The email:** It tells her which charge is the duplicate and that the full $144 will be refunded.
